title: Feature+ and the new Extras page
notes: Feature+: one switch that adds new things you can do in Yapin’. Each one has its own switch:
Save any message and find it again later (Ctrl+Shift+B), give people private notes and nicknames only you can see, and fold away…
Copy or quote a message, get reminded about a message later, and turn a message into a picture card to save or share
Find in chat (Ctrl+Shift+L), a quick switcher for channels, servers, saved messages and Studio pages (Ctrl+Shift+K), a picture viewer…
